hub.title: Games
chicken.title: Chicken Pursuit
chicken.instructions: You and another chicken race to the food. Arrow keys stay aimed at north, marked by the arrow, and do not turn with the yard. Higher levels grow the yard, turn it more often, and speed the other chicken.
chicken.controls.desktop: Arrow keys or WASD follow north. A tap on the yard moves toward that spot. Space or Enter starts the next race.
chicken.controls.touch: The pad follows north. A tap on the yard moves toward that spot. Tap Again for the next race.
void.title: Space Warp
void.instructions: Shoot the ships and rocks. Each hit costs hull.
void.controls.desktop: WASD or the arrow keys fly. Click to aim and hold to shoot, or hold Space. Space starts the next run.
void.controls.touch: Drag to fly. Hold still to shoot, or add a second finger while dragging. Tap Again for the next run.
cog.title: Biases
cog.instructions: Pick a bias. Read the plain explanation and the paper, then open its game.
cog.controls.desktop: Click a bias to open its game, or click the paper. In a round, drag the bar or use the arrow keys, then press Enter.
cog.controls.touch: Tap a bias to open its game, or tap the paper. In a round, drag the bar, then tap That's my guess.
cog.lead: A plain explanation, the paper, and a game for each.
cog.stub.body: This game is not built yet.
anchor.intro.body: Six questions. Each one has a number next to it. Drag the bar to your answer. Then you see whether that number pulled you off the real one.
anchor.seen: A note beside the question says {anchor}.
anchor.guess.help: Drag the bar to your own guess. It does not have to match the note.
anchor.guess.help2: Move the bar only if the note changes your mind.
anchor.gut.help: No note yet. Drag the bar to the number you would answer.
anchor.reveal.truth: The real answer is {truth}. You said {guess}. The note said {anchor}.
anchor.reveal.shift: Before the note you said {gut}. After it, {guess}.
anchor.verdict.high: The note pulled you most of the way.
anchor.verdict.mid: The note pulled you part of the way.
anchor.verdict.away: You did not follow the note.
anchor.verdict.what: That pull is anchoring. The first number sticks, and the guess drifts toward it.
anchor.verdict.whatnot: The note did not pull you. Anchoring is when it does: the first number sticks, and the guess drifts toward it.
anchor.tip.title: Guess before you look
anchor.tip.body: For the last three, set your guess first. Then the note appears. Move the bar only if you actually change your mind.
anchor.done.title: Did the note pull you?
anchor.done.cold: First three: {pct}% of the way toward the note.
anchor.done.aided: Last three, after guessing first: {pct}% of the way.
anchor.done.note: Lower is better. Guessing your own number first is the fix.
bias.anchoring.name: Anchoring
bias.anchoring.body: The first number you hear sticks, and your guess slides toward it.
bias.availability.name: Availability
bias.availability.body: If an example pops into your head easily, you think it happens a lot.
bias.representativeness.name: Representativeness
bias.representativeness.body: A story that sounds right beats the real odds.
bias.confirmation.name: Confirmation
bias.confirmation.body: You look for proof that you were already right.
bias.sunk.name: Sunk cost
bias.sunk.body: You keep going because of money or time you already spent.
bias.overconfidence.name: Overconfidence
bias.overconfidence.body: You feel more sure than your right answers deserve.
bias.blind.name: Blind spot
bias.blind.body: You spot this mistake in other people, and miss it in yourself.
bias.framing.name: Framing
bias.framing.body: The same fact feels different told as a win or as a loss.
bias.loss.name: Loss aversion
bias.loss.body: Losing something hurts more than gaining the same thing feels good.
bias.hindsight.name: Hindsight
bias.hindsight.body: After it happens, you feel like you knew it all along.
bias.planning.name: Planning fallacy
bias.planning.body: You plan for the smooth day, not the usual messy one.

sub.meter.title: Bias pull
sub.meter.note: Lower is better. The fix is to use the strategy card.
anchor.spin.help: Spin lands on a number. Then guess.
anchor.range.help: Set your low end before the wheel. That is the fix.
confirm.intro: Test triples. Find the hidden rule.
confirm.tip.title: Try to break your idea
confirm.tip.body: Submit a triple you think will fail the rule.
confirm.reveal.break: You tried to break the rule. Good.
confirm.reveal.confirm: You only checked a matching triple.
sub.confirm.controls.desktop: Type three numbers, then Test triple.
sub.confirm.controls.touch: Enter three numbers, then tap Test triple.
over.intro: Set a range you are 90% sure contains the answer.
over.tip.title: Bet test
over.tip.body: Would you bet on your range or on a 90% wheel slice?
sub.over.controls.touch: Drag the bar, then tap Next.
rep.question: A cab was blue in a hit-and-run. Witness said blue. Chance it was blue?
rep.tip.title: Picture 100
rep.tip.body: Think in counts out of 100, not percentages.
avail.q.plane: More deaths a year: plane crash or car crash?
avail.q.car: More deaths: car crash or plane crash?
avail.headline.plane: Breaking: dramatic plane crash dominates the news.
avail.headline.flood: Breaking: flood footage loops on every channel.
avail.tip.title: Ask for the count
avail.tip.body: Ignore the headline. Compare yearly totals.
sunk.intro: Dig for gold or leave the mine.
sunk.tip.title: Only ahead counts
sunk.tip.body: Ignore sunk cost. Leave when the next dig is not worth it.
sunk.reveal: Past digs do not change what is left in the ground.
frame.intro: Same lives saved or lost. Different words.
frame.gain: Program A saves 200 of 800. Program B: 1/3 chance to save all. Pick.
frame.loss: Program C kills 600 of 800. Program D: 1/3 chance none die. Pick.
frame.tip.title: Say it both ways
frame.tip.body: Rewrite as gain and as loss before you choose.
frame.reveal: Same numbers. Different frame flipped your choice.
loss.intro: Take or skip fair-ish coin flips.
loss.tip.title: See ten at once
loss.tip.body: Imagine ten such bets, not one.
loss.reveal: You need more upside than loss to say yes. That is loss aversion.
hind.recall: After the outcome: what was your confidence?
hind.tip.title: Write it down
hind.tip.body: Log confidence before you know the outcome.
plan.intro: Estimate seconds, then do a quick task.
plan.tip.title: Reference class
plan.tip.body: Use your past actual times before you guess.
blind.intro: Rate your bias vs others, then compare to your meters.
blind.prompt: How biased are you vs the average person (1–10)?
blind.reveal: You rated yourself {self}, others {other}. Your games averaged {measured}% pull.
blind.tip.title: Trust the meter
blind.tip.body: Feelings lie. Scores from the other games do not.
blind.done: Play other biases first for a fuller picture.
